# rustfs_module_switch (Resource)

Manage RustFS feature module switches (notify and audit modules).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "rustfs_module_switch" "test" {
  notify_enabled = true
  audit_enabled  = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `audit_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the audit module is enabled.
- `notify_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the notify module is enabled.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Fixed identifier for the module switch set.
